name: cost-guard
description: Daily and monthly spend guard for Claude Code. Blocks prompts once you exceed your budget and shows a live burn status line. Powered by ccusage over your local transcripts — no API key, no network beyond ccusage, no telemetry.

monthly_target.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_target.description: Target monthly spend. Prompts are blocked once month-to-date reaches this.

working_days_per_month.title: Working days per month
working_days_per_month.description: Daily budget = monthly budget / this. Use 30 for calendar-day pacing, ~21 for working days.

warn_pct.title: Warn threshold (%)
warn_pct.description: The status line turns amber once today's spend passes this percent of the daily budget.

hard_block.title: Block when over budget
hard_block.description: On = block prompts once over budget. Off = warn only, never block.

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl.description: How long to cache ccusage results between recomputations, so transcripts are not rescanned on every prompt.
